|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Rey With Lightsaber (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-reywithlightsaber_ai-2022-01-15.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021; left = before, right = after): [[File:V9-L-reywithlightsaber_ai-2022-01-15-vs-hires-2021-08-10-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[Rey With Lightsaber (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-reywithlightsaberaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/reywithlightsaber_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/reywithlightsaber_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Armed And Dangerous”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Permanent weapon is •Anakin's Lightsaber (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, its forfeit = 0, and you may retrieve 1 Force, if total destiny > defense value).”
